items.name: Driller
items.description: Swings a drill bit in wide arcs and charges straight through a kick. Easy to learn and hits hard up close.
items.flavor: Weight on bit, rotary on. Make hole.
items.abilityDescription: Dash forward with the bit spinning, hitting everything in your path for 200% weapon damage.

items.name: Toolpusher
items.description: The boss of the rig floor. Slow, heavy slams that knock enemies back, and a horn that rallies the whole crew.
items.flavor: Nobody goes home until the casing is on bottom.
items.abilityDescription: Units within 12 m heal 30% and deal 40% more damage for 6 seconds.

items.name: Perforation Specialist
items.description: A completions hand who shoots shaped charges. Fragile but deadly at range.
items.flavor: Perforate the casing, connect the well to the rock.
items.abilityDescription: Fire 9 shaped charges in a wide cone, each for 120% weapon damage.

items.name: Mud Engineer
items.description: Sprays weighted drilling fluid that slows and pushes enemies away from the walls.
items.flavor: Keep the hydrostatic above the pore pressure and nothing comes up the hole.
items.abilityDescription: Unleash a wave of kill-weight mud: enemies within 8 m take 40 damage, are pushed back and slowed by 50% for 4 seconds.

items.name: Geophysicist
items.description: Lobs seismic pulses that burst on impact. Weak alone, devastating on crowds.
items.flavor: Every wave you send down comes back with a story.
items.abilityDescription: Detonate a shot point: 60 damage to enemies within 7 m and stun them for 1.5 seconds.
